description: This Java class TableUpdateHandler manages updates to tables within the EFI tuning software, handling registration, deregistration, and data updates for tables related to ECU sensor data, including sensor listener callbacks.

classes.name: TableUpdateHandler
classes.description: Singleton class that manages registration and updates of data tables linked to ECU sensor data. It listens to sensor updates, updates registered tables, and manages axes registration for 2D and 3D tables.

methods.name: registerData
methods.description: Registers LoggerData objects to be monitored (implementation is empty).

methods.name: handleDataUpdate
methods.description: Updates tables with new data from responses, highlighting live data based on formatted values.

methods.name: registerTable
methods.description: Registers a Table or its axes for update tracking based on log parameters.

methods.name: deregisterTable
methods.description: Deregisters a Table or its axes from update tracking.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TableUpdateHandler.

methods.name: registerAxes
methods.description: Registers axes of 2D or 3D tables for update.
